{{short description|Czech mathematician}}
'''Bohuslav Balcar''' ({{IPA|cs|ˈboɦuslav ˈbaltsar}}; 1943 – 2017)  was a [[Czech people|Czech]] [[mathematician]]. He was a senior researcher at the Center for Theoretical Study (CTS), and a professor at [[Charles University in Prague]]. His research interests were mainly related to [[foundations of mathematics]].

Balcar received his [[Ph.D.]] in 1966 from Charles University. His Ph.D. supervisor was [[Petr Vopěnka]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|134872}}</ref>
